items.title: AI news, a few lines each
items.text: New open models, runtime releases, and AI labs' announcements, from the news toskar.ai writes every morning. A model in Toskar's catalog shows how well it fits this computer, and Admins can install it from there. Turn it off in Settings.

items.title: Toskar in your CI
items.text: Ask your own AI from a CI job: summarize a bug, suggest labels, read a failing log. A key for a CI job can only ask, with no memories, knowledge, or tools. Use toskarctl ask, install.sh ci, or the Ask Toskar action for GitHub.

items.title: Official SDKs for Python, JavaScript, and Go
items.text: Build on Toskar with the official SDKs, from PyPI, npm, and Go modules: stream answers, watch events, and connect as a device at home or from anywhere. Every example is tested against Core on each change.

items.title: A truer OpenAI-compatible API
items.text: Pictures reach the model, a JSON Schema is used whole, and answers carry their own id, token usage, and why they stopped, so OpenAI libraries and tools work with Toskar as they do elsewhere.

items.title: Text can't pose as the model's own turn
items.text: A web page, a file, or a visitor's message that spells a model's control tokens can no longer start a turn of its own. Everything a model reads is escaped on its way in.

items.title: Models you copied in show up
items.text: A model file put in Toskar's models folder by hand now appears on the Models page, and Add model › From another app adds it where it is, without a copy.
